name: specraft
description: Injects specraft project context, exposes MCP tools, and enforces commit/push/ingest stop gates.

api_key.title: Specraft API key
api_key.description: Stored in the system keychain and exported to the specraft MCP proxy as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_API_KEY. Leave empty to use the SPECRAFT_API_KEY env var or ~/.specraft/credentials instead.
